description: This file defines the Mongoose schema and model for 'Post' documents in a social media backend, including embedded media schema, indexes, and associations with 'User'.

classes.name: MediaSchema
classes.description: Embedded schema for media associated with a Post, including URL, type, dimensions, and duration.

classes.name: PostSchema
classes.description: Schema defining the structure of a Post document, including references, content, media, visibility, metrics, and indexes.

methods.name: mongoose.model
methods.description: Creates and exports the Post model based on PostSchema.
